response.sql: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count, SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT AVG(c.player_count) AS avg_player_count, AVG(1.0 * c.player_count / o.total_count) AS avg_fraction_of_total, AVG(c.player_count - o.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM college_counts AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE c.player_count > o.avg_count
